title: Not Eligible | ASL | Employee OAL
description:
OAL (partner airline) employee on an Israel route. Employee exclusion is universal � blocks eligibility under ASL just as it does under APPR (TC_040) and EU 261 (TC_119). Validates that the employee override applies consistently across all three regimes.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (OAL Employee). Employee Flag: OAL EMPLOYEE BOOKING in Trip Tracer. Journey: Israel route (AC operated). Disruption: Controllable delay. Regime: ASL applicable (Israel route).
